units.source_text: 头中将说到这里，装作老成模样，叹一口气。

en.t: When the Captain had said this much, he put on an air of worldly maturity and sighed.

units.source_text: 源氏公子并不完全赞同这番话，但觉也有符合自己意见之处，便笑道：“真个全无半点才艺的女人，有没有呢？”

en.t: Prince Genji did not entirely agree with what had been said, but feeling that some of it matched his own thoughts, he smiled and asked, "Is there really such a thing as a woman with not the slightest accomplishment at all?"
The Captain began to set forth his views again:
